title: chrysobalanus icaco var. chariensis
intro: Chrysobalanus icaco var. chariensis, commonly known as the West Indian Locust, is a plant species native to the Caribbean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of Chrysobalanus icaco var. chariensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
